keeper.ambient: quiet, unhurried hammering from the workshop bench

lines.default: The Keeper nods without stopping his work. "Road's quiet. Brook's running. That's most of the news there is."
lines.first: The Keeper looks up from his bench. "Another pair of hands in the valley. Good. Things here keep working because somebody keeps visiting them."
lines.holds_lantern: The Keeper glances at the lantern in your hand. "That one's been dark since before my time. Dry as a bone. There's oil on my bench if you've a mind to wake it."
lines.holds_oil: "Mind the spout," the Keeper says. "It pours quicker than you expect."
lines.lantern_lit: The Keeper looks toward the hill, though he cannot see it from here. "Saw a light up on Watch Hill. First in years. The valley noticed, I promise you."

keeper.name: the Keeper

apple.desc: A ripe apple, red where the sun found it, hanging at hand height.
apple.name: apple

bench.desc: A scarred workbench, worn smooth in the middle where hands have passed for years.
bench.name: workbench

lantern.desc: A brass lantern hangs on the post, well-made and dry. It has not been lit in a long time.
lantern.name: brass lantern

oil-can.desc: A long-spouted oil can sits on the bench, still heavy with oil.
oil-can.name: oil can

stone-marker.desc: A standing stone with carved letters, weathered almost to smoothness.
stone-marker.inscription: WHAT YOU CARRY UP, CARRY BACK DOWN. THE VALLEY KEEPS WHAT IS LEFT WITH CARE.
stone-marker.name: stone marker

brook-bridge.ambient: running water over round stones, close and constant
brook-bridge.desc: A wooden bridge, silvered with age, crosses a clear brook. The water talks quietly to itself over round stones. South, a path climbs toward a bare hill.
brook-bridge.desc_dark: You hear the brook before you see the bridge. The water carries what little light the sky gives.
brook-bridge.name: The Brook Bridge

crossroads.desc: A lantern post stands where three ways meet, its lamp dark. A low wind moves through grass that has never been cut. The valley opens below you, quiet in every direction.
crossroads.desc_dark: The lantern post is a dark shape against a darker sky. The ways out of the crossroads are felt more than seen.
crossroads.name: The Crossroads

orchard.ambient: leaves, and now and then the soft drop of a ripe apple
orchard.desc: Gnarled apple trees in rough rows, more years behind them than ahead. Fruit hangs where it ripened, unpicked. The bees have gone home; the sweetness stays.
orchard.desc_dark: The orchard is a crowd of patient silhouettes. Fallen apples sweeten the dark.
orchard.name: The Old Orchard

valley-road.ambient: gravel settling under nothing, far-off wind
valley-road.desc: A worn dirt road descending between low, grassy hills. Somebody kept this road once; the ruts are old and smooth. A side path branches east toward a stone building.
valley-road.desc_dark: The road is a pale ribbon in the dark. The hills on either side keep their own counsel.
valley-road.name: The Valley Road

watch-hill.ambient: high wind, unobstructed, smelling of coming weather
watch-hill.desc: A bare hill above the valley. At its top stands a weathered stone marker, its face covered in carved letters worn nearly smooth. From here the whole valley is visible — crossroads, brook, orchard, workshop roof — all of it small and held.
watch-hill.desc_dark: From Watch Hill the valley is a map of faint shapes. The stone marker's carved face cannot be read in this light.
watch-hill.name: Watch Hill

workshop.ambient: a small fire ticking in a stove; metal cooling
workshop.desc: A stone workshop smelling of oil and cut wood. A bench runs along one wall under a row of patient tools. The Keeper works here, mending things that are brought to him.
workshop.desc_dark: The workshop holds the day's warmth a little longer than the road does. Shapes of tools rest along the wall.
workshop.name: The Workshop
